scripts.predev: node scripts/stop-dev-server.mjs && npm run assets:optimize && npm run sync:gear-art && npm run sounds:optimize && npm run music:optimize
scripts.predev:desktop: node scripts/stop-dev-server.mjs && npm run assets:optimize && npm run sync:gear-art && npm run sounds:optimize && npm run music:optimize
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/sync-version-metadata.mjs && npm run assets:optimize && npm run sync:gear-art && npm run sounds:optimize && npm run music:optimize
scripts.prebuild:desktop: node scripts/sync-version-metadata.mjs && node scripts/sync-steam-appid.mjs && npm run assets:optimize && npm run sync:gear-art && npm run sounds:optimize && npm run music:optimize
scripts.package:win: npm run compile:desktop && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.package:win:full: npm run build:desktop && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:desktop && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation electron-builder --win
scripts.test:ship: npm run test:ship:unit && npm run test:ship:e2e
scripts.test:ship:unit: vitest run tests/features/storage tests/features/storage/bootstrap-save-state.test.ts tests/features/app/autosave-hook.test.ts tests/features/storage-io-cloud-merge.test.ts tests/features/storage-backup.test.ts tests/lib/validation tests/architecture tests/scripts tests/lib/validation/save-merge.test.ts
scripts.test:ship:e2e: playwright test tests/save-persistence.spec.ts tests/save-error-paths.spec.ts tests/save-mid-combat-resume.spec.ts tests/save-unsupported-version.spec.ts --project chromium
scripts.test:ship:desktop: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_ELECTRON_PREVIEW_PORT=4175 node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.electron.config.ts
scripts.build:ship: npm run build && npm run compile:desktop
scripts.check:ship: npm run lint:ci && npm run test:ship:unit && npm run build:ship
scripts.check:ship:ci: npm run test:ship:unit && npm run compile:desktop
scripts.check:ship:full: npm run check:ship && npm run test:ship:e2e && npm run test:ship:desktop
scripts.test:e2e:prepush: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_VITE_MODE=preview PLAYWRIGHT_PREPUSH=1 playwright test --project chromium --grep @prepush
scripts.test:e2e:prepush:full: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_VITE_MODE=preview CI=true npm run test:e2e:critical
scripts.test:e2e:main-gate: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_VITE_MODE=preview PLAYWRIGHT_E2E_FULL=1 CI=true playwright test --project chromium
scripts.test:e2e:preview: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_VITE_MODE=preview PLAYWRIGHT_E2E_FULL=1 CI=true playwright test --project chromium
scripts.test:e2e:nightly: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_VITE_MODE=preview PLAYWRIGHT_E2E_FULL=1 PLAYWRIGHT_NIGHTLY=1 CI=true playwright test --project chromium
scripts.test:e2e:electron: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_ELECTRON_PREVIEW_PORT=4175 node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.electron.config.ts
scripts.balance:sim: cross-env ALCHEMY_BALANCE_SIM=1 vitest run tests/balance/balance-report.test.ts --reporter=verbose && start "" reports\balance-report.html
scripts.check: npm ci --dry-run && npm run lint:ci && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check:push: npm run check && npm run test:e2e:prepush
scripts.lint:ci: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run deadcode
